abstract class Abstract {
  abstract run(): number;
}
class Concrete {
  run() {
    return 1;
  }
}
function create<T extends typeof Abstract | typeof Concrete>(constructor: T) {
  return new constructor();
}
create(Abstract);

abstract class EmptyAbstract {}
class EmptyConcrete {}
function createEmpty<T extends typeof EmptyConcrete | typeof EmptyAbstract>(constructor: T) {
  return new constructor();
}
createEmpty(EmptyConcrete);

type AbstractConstructor = abstract new (value: number) => object;
type ConcreteConstructor = new (value: number) => object;
function createFromSignatures<T extends ConcreteConstructor | AbstractConstructor>(constructor: T) {
  return new constructor(1);
}
function createFromIntersection<T extends ConcreteConstructor & AbstractConstructor>(constructor: T) {
  return new constructor(1);
}
function createConcrete<T extends typeof Concrete | typeof EmptyConcrete>(constructor: T) {
  return new constructor();
}
